scripts.title: TR4GIX DESTROYER
scripts.features:
MESSAGES,JAIL,LOOP KILL ALL,disco,dark and more!

(Only works on client replication games because its client script)
scripts.script:
for _,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then local cf = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame; for i=1,4 do local p = Instance.new('Part', workspace); p.Size = Vector3.new(10,15,1); p.Anchored = true; p.CFrame = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i*90), 0) * CFrame.new(0,0,5) end end end for _,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(function() local m = Instance.new('Message', v.PlayerGui); m.Text = 'HACKED BY TR4GIX'; game.Debris:AddItem(m, 100) end) end spawn(function() while true do for i=1,5 do local h = Instance.new('Hint', workspace); h.Text = 'TR4GIX WAS HERE | The Velardia' end; task.wait(0.10000000); for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA('Hint') then v:Destroy() end end end end) spawn(function() while wait() do local c = Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1); game.Lighting.FogColor = c; game.Lighting.Ambient = c; game.Lighting.FogEnd = 200; task.wait() end end) spawn(function() while wait(1) do for _,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then pcall(function() v.Character:BreakJoints() end) end end end end)

for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
	if v.className == "Sound" then
		v:Stop()
		v:Remove()	
	end	
end
s = Instance.new("Sound",Workspace)
s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://72089843969979"
s.Volume = 1
s.Looped = true
s.Pitch = 0.2
s:Play()
wait(.1)
